name: Killed by EA
description: A dated, sourced archive of what Electronic Arts killed: games cancelled in development, studios closed or merged, and projects it ended, on one searchable timeline up to a stated cutoff.
problem: The record of what EA killed is split across Wikipedia's acquisitions table (many closures without a year), a studios-only graveyard site, a cancelled-games archive with no publisher view, and years of one-off news posts, so there is no single dated timeline of EA's cancelled games, closed studios, and ended projects to search or cite.
